architectureContracts: Frontend: Homepage, Auth and Product share canonical VI tokens, approved assets/fonts, locale/RTL, focus/motion, capability presentation and safe route context; no second client truth source.
WorkspaceEntryContextV1 allows stable source/locale/intent/presentation/scenario/resource IDs only; raw prompts, credentials, order/passport content and PII never enter URL/referrer/analytics.

Frontend release is deny-by-default for blocked source hashes, unapproved assets, map-on state, missing licences/SBOM/NOTICE, over-claimed store screenshots or incomplete parity/accessibility evidence.
TurnCoordinator: start/observe/get/cancel; owns intent, retrieval, routing, validation, durable events, resume.
TripWorkspace: get/createProposal/confirmAndApplyProposal/applyUserEdit; owns immutable revisions, CAS, patch transaction, audit.
KnowledgeSystem: resolveEvidence/explore/prepareImport/commitImport/reviewAndPublish; owns identity, Fact, eligibility, projections.
ExternalEvidenceResolver: resolve(closed DataNeed union); owns provider/policy/cache/TTL/attribution.
BatchTranslation and RealtimeTranslation are separate seams sharing TranslationRevision/Evidence/Policy types.
ModelGateway seam: invoke(taskRequest, signal); validates provider protocol/transport/schema only, never domain truth.
JobExecutor, OperationalRecorder and ActorResolver seams each require one deterministic fake plus one production adapter.
ApplyOutcome is a closed union; callers never parse exception strings.
Closed failure taxonomy (UNAUTHENTICATED..INTERNAL_ERROR) is frozen with HTTP/SSE mapping, five-language copy, retryability and metric labels.
All contracts are frozen as schema fixture plus consumer test; provider SDK types never define domain schema.
